Q9033.reason: VCLT Article 31 requires good-faith interpretation by ordinary meaning in context and in light of object and purpose; preparatory works are only supplementary.

Q9036.reason: A keloid is an overgrown firm mass of scar tissue beyond the original wound, not a fine hairline scar or a drain-timing complication.

Q9037.reason: Prolonged ventilation and weaning is a standard tracheostomy indication; a tracheostomy does not repair paralyzed vocal cords.
